|lore=Sand People use a special mask to reclaim exhaled moisture in the hot, harsh environment of Tatooine. Protects by filtering blowing sand and dispersing excess heat.
|game_text=Deploy on a battleground location. X = the face-up destiny number of your Objective. While all your ability on table is provided only by aliens, creature vehicles, and Independent starship pilots, you are considered to have +X in total ability at locations you occupy, and once per turn you may ignore up to X in battle damage. Canceled if opponent controls this location. (Immune to Alter.)
|errata_history=Versions of [[Tusken Breath Mask (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 2, slip 22 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “Deploy on a battleground location. X = the face-up destiny number of your Objective. While all your ability on table is provided only by aliens, creature vehicles, and Independent starship pilots, you are considered to have +X in total ability at locations you occupy, and once per turn you may ignore up to X in battle damage. Canceled if opponent controls this location. A” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•22” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 22), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face-up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, your total ability during battle at a site is +X. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card. The Committee's errata sheet “Errata: September 17, 2007” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20071026144228/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/Errata9_17.pdf Errata9_17.pdf], Internet Archive capture 26 October 2007) reprints this slip unchanged ([[:File:OVS8-22-Tusken_Breath_Mask-errata-sheet-2007-09-17.png]]), so it is an extra image of this version, not a new one. The December 2006 wording before that errata is not preserved: every surviving copy of the Remaster sheet already carries it. The Committee's errata sheet “Errata: September 17, 2007” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20071026144228/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/Errata9_17.pdf Errata9_17.pdf], Internet Archive capture 26 October 2007) reprints this slip unchanged ([[:File:OVS8-22-Tusken_Breath_Mask-errata-sheet-2007-09-17.png]]), so it is an extra image of this version, not a new one. The December 2006 wording before that errata is not preserved: every surviving copy of the Remaster sheet already carries it.
